text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A big sister who never gives up is the 
strongest Umamusume of all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(The ones who don't give up are the strong 
ones. 
...That's so true—it really is.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Meddling really isn't my style, but—
Hey, Sky-san!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing over here? I've been 
looking all over for you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whaa, as expected of King! Perfect timing! 
Well, you see, I spotted a girl who looked 
a bit lost, so I got worried~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eh, who?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I thought King might need some 
mental prep too. 
I mean, if you mess up the tablecloth 
pull, your chances of becoming the Muse 
are basically hopeless, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are you talking about?! 
I wouldn't give up over failing just once, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If it doesn't work this year, there's next 
year, and if not next year, then the one 
after that! 
I'll challenge it as many times as it 
takes until I become the Muse!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't give up, you haven't 
lost. 
You just haven't won yet—that's all there 
is to it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yup, King's wild logic really does 
cheer you up! 
I'm so glad I got to hear it here♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —King-san...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(She's right... As long as I don't give 
up, I haven't lost. 
That's exactly it—!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the 2nd checkpoint has turned 
into an unexpected bottleneck! 
Perhaps due to the immense pressure, 
failed attempts keep piling up!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Well, here I go.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (It's okay... I am strong—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Because I haven't lost yet. 
This is nothing more than a step along the 
path to my eventual victory—!)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“Now then, Verxina-chan, are you ready~? 
You get one chance! Right now, this is 
it!”

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: “Take your stance... 3, 2, 1—”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haah...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!! Big sis!! 
I knew you could do it!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
See, I told you so! You're number one, Big 
sis! 
My big sister is the coolest in the whole 
wide world!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you, Vivlos. 
I was only able to take on this challenge 
thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's not it at all! You're the 
amazing one, Big Sis! 
You really are the big sister I'm most 
proud of!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Then I absolutely have to 
become the muse and make you even prouder! 
Let's go, Vivlos—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And now, the audition reaches its climax! 
Our muse candidates race through the final 
maze!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Only three pairs remain! The King Halo 
pair, the Verxina pair, 
and the solo participant, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, not bad! So you made it too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am the King, so of course!  
I will definitely make it through this 
audition!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either! On my pride and 
prestige as a queen—

text_block_list.name: All Five
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Welcome, my diamonds in the rough!! 
This is the final checkpoint!!”

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“The task here is extremely simple! 
Sprint down the Wedding Road without 
getting caught by the obstacle bots!”

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: “Show me your passion!!”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Time is tight, and if we're caught, 
we're out. 
It certainly sounds simple enough in 
practice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Sky!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then~ when it comes to front-running, 
leave it to Sei-chan♪ 
King, don't space out and get caught, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You always have to say one thing too many! 
As if the King would ever make such a 
rookie mis— Ah!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa—!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look out, focus, King! 
Isn't a first-rate lady supposed to win 
with ease?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, I'm about to show you that right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Woooo!! As expected of King, what an 
incredible cut-in!” 
“Sky's diversion is great too, the robotic 
arms are totally split!!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Lady Verxina!! Vivlos-chan, hang in there 
too—!!” 
“Verxina!! Don't you dare lose—!!”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa, there are way too many 
arms!! We can't outrun them~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! 
The spirit to challenge and refuse defeat 
is what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Look for an opening and burst forward at 
full speed! 
Vivlos, stay close to me—!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
The candidates boldly face the relentless 
onslaught of the incoming arms!!!! 
Both Team King Halo and Team Verxina aim 
for a tiny gap—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
There they goooo!!!! An assault!! 
Lightning fast!!!! 
DODGING the fiercely pursuing arms, they 
now—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
CROSS THE GOAL!! Team King Halo and Team 
Verxina 
clear the checkpoint! But wait, what is 
happening over there!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho!! She hasn't taken a single 
step before the final challenge! 
Just what is she planning—!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—I was just scoping it out. 
To see if this stage was truly worthy of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And it went way beyond my expectations!! 
Both King and Verxina were shining just 
like veteran witches!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I can't let myself lose 
either!! 
Because I came here today to show 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Magical Girl Sweepy's special magic!
